AC_LAYERING.basis: A0 traceability maps its horizontal layered architecture to AC_LAYERING; the frozen A0 fitness configuration activates architecture compliance and the frozen Import Linter configuration encodes the layer rules. This supports applicability only; evaluator adequacy, pair validity, and compliance remain separate questions.

AC_MODULE_STRUCTURE.basis: A0 is the monolith source state; the A0.1 state manifest declares capability modules and their required structure. This supports the state distinction only; evaluator adequacy, pair validity, and compliance remain separate questions.

applicability_assumptions.policy_interpretation: The per-state classifications above are applied as direct TEST_ONLY state assumptions in an isolated policy source. They are not approved research policy, an external authority finding, or a DA01 authorization.

pair_evidence_rules.b0_scope_mismatch: If the pinned B0 evaluator execution reports a configured module target absent from the pinned A0.1 source inventory, classify only that B0 representation-obligation pair as TEST_ONLY INVALID for scope incompatibility. Preserve the process result and do not interpret it as an A0.1 architecture violation.
pair_evidence_rules.candidate_semantics: Admit only digest-validated actual evaluator execution records. Do not create positive exact-pair semantic proofs. Candidate pair validity remains UNKNOWN until independently established.
pair_evidence_rules.candidate_evaluator_execution: Run a profile evaluator only when the materialized candidate row, source revision, configuration and evaluator artifact digests, applicability scope, lifecycle stage, covered obligation, and complete evidence contract match the pinned profile. A full candidate validation failure remains a failure even if scoped profile evaluators execute.

candidate_cost_model.unit: declared development unit; not currency or measured runtime

measurement_rules.evaluator_execution: Record each actual subprocess duration, exit status, stdout and stderr digests separately for frozen B0 and the candidate-profile evaluators.
measurement_rules.coverage: Report exact pair and Coverage_P states from the trace. Do not calculate numeric coverage unless applicability, denominator, and exact-pair semantic evidence are independently established.
measurement_rules.detection_behavior: Report evaluator output and scoped pair diagnostics separately; a process pass is not proof of semantic adequacy or architecture compliance.
measurement_rules.evaluation_overhead: Report B0 and each candidate-profile evaluator duration separately. Do not claim speedup because scopes and evaluator counts differ.
measurement_rules.controlled_violation: Reuse existing PILOT-01 S1 only as a secondary evaluator control; it is not another architecture transition or independent sample.
